description: Canonical feature contract shared by the Swift FeatureEncoder (inference) and the Python trainer. If these two drift, accuracy silently collapses. v3: hands_only. MediaPipe and Apple Vision agree on the 21-point hand skeleton but not on face or body topology (468 vs ~76 face points; different pose joints), so training on those regions teaches patterns that are noise at inference. Their slots are kept but zeroed on both sides, which avoids changing the tensor shape. uses_depth is false: Vision supplies no z on the camera path, so the model is trained with depth zeroed. The encoder zeroes it too, which also keeps visionOS hand tracking — which does supply real depth — consistent with training.

normalization.scale: euclidean distance between body point 0 and body point 1

continuous.description: Level-3 CTC path: variable-ish length context of frames -> per-timestep logits over vocab + blank. Consumed by the Swift ContinuousSignRecognizer and produced by training/model_ctc.py.
